metadata.query: Analyze Q3 2026 enterprise AI infrastructure spending trends

steps.thought: Initial query received. I need to break down enterprise AI infrastructure spending into hardware, cloud hosting, and inference orchestration.

contextMessages.content: You are a senior tech analyst agent. Formulate structured research plans and invoke search tools to find current data.
Analyze Q3 2026 enterprise AI infrastructure spending trends and provide a cost breakdown.

steps.thought: Querying latest financial filings and cloud provider capex reports for AI workloads.

contextMessages.content: You are a senior tech analyst agent. Formulate structured research plans and invoke search tools to find current data.
Analyze Q3 2026 enterprise AI infrastructure spending trends and provide a cost breakdown.
I will execute concurrent searches on enterprise cloud earnings and accelerator supply chains.

steps.thought: Examining SEC 10-Q disclosures extracted from cloud vendors. Need to fetch full tables on GPU cluster leasing.

contextMessages.content: You are a senior tech analyst agent.
Received 8 market reports. One report from hyperscalers highlights a 38% increase in inference spend relative to training.

steps.thought: Synthesizing executive summary with comparative tables and projected 2027 CAGR.

contextMessages.content: You are a senior tech analyst agent.
Synthesizing data into three pillars: Private On-Prem Clusters, Managed Cloud GPUs, and Token-as-a-Service routing.

spans.name: Decompose Query & Formulate Plan
spans.agentThought: Deconstruct user prompt into 3 search queries: Hyperscaler CapEx, Custom Silicon deployment, and Token API spending.

spans.name: Planner LLM Call
spans.promptText: Plan a research workflow for enterprise AI infrastructure spend in Q3 2026.
spans.completionText: Plan: 1) Query cloud earnings reports. 2) Check private cloud cluster growth. 3) Compare training vs inference ratios.

spans.name: Execute Web Retrieval
spans.agentThought: Issuing concurrent web requests to fetch Gartner and IDC data points.

spans.name: Tool Selection Inference
spans.promptText: Generate search queries for IDC and Gartner enterprise AI cloud report 2026.
spans.completionText: call: search_web(query='Q3 2026 enterprise AI infrastructure capex Gartner'); call: search_web(query='Hyperscaler inference cluster capex quarterly report')

inputArgs.query: Q3 2026 enterprise AI infrastructure capex Gartner

results.title: Gartner AI Infrastructure Spending Report
results.snippet: Global enterprise spend on generative AI infrastructure reached $84.2B in Q3 2026, up 42% YoY.

results.title: IDC Cloud Pulse
results.snippet: Inference now accounts for 61% of total enterprise compute spending.

inputArgs.query: Hyperscaler inference cluster capex quarterly report

results.title: Hyperscaler Capex Q3
results.snippet: Aggregate hyperscaler capital expenditure crossed $65B with hardware accelerators leading at 72% allocation.

spans.name: Deep Content Parsing
spans.agentThought: Checking detailed breakdown tables from the primary IDC source URL.

spans.name: Evaluator LLM Call
spans.promptText: Evaluate sufficiency of search snippets. Fetch URL if deep breakdown tables are missing.
spans.completionText: The high-level figures are clear, but we need the exact sub-breakdown for networking vs accelerators. Fetching document.

spans.agentThought: All metrics compiled. Drafting finalized structured research brief with cost tables.

spans.name: Synthesis Model Call
spans.promptText: Synthesize the gathered metrics into a structured executive report.
spans.completionText:
